h1: Custom Collapsible Golf Items for Events
metaTitle: Custom Collapsible Golf Items | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom collapsible golf items for your next event. Perfect for giveaways and tournaments. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Collapsible golf items offer a practical advantage for tournament giveaways and corporate outings. Unlike standard golf accessories, these fold down compactly for easy storage in a golf bag or glove compartment. The Bitty Umbrella with a 40-inch arc provides quick shelter from sun or rain and collapses to fit in a carry bag. Add your logo with screen printing or debossing for a professional look that attendees will actually use.
heroAltText: Custom collapsible golf umbrella with logo, 40-inch arc, folded compactly
